operations.rationale: Both nodes represent the Supreme Court's confirmation of the Regional Court's judgment on 10 August 1998. doc:proceeding_9 has more properties and a more comprehensive label/quote.

The quotes indicate these were two requests (dismissal of judge and admission of lawyer) rejected by the same court on the same day as part of the same procedural step in the retrial. They are merged into a single proceeding representing the court's interlocutory decisions on 19 May.

doc:proceeding_3 is the main retrial judgment of 27 May 1998. doc:proceeding_7 refers to 'further orders' made on the same day by the same court in the same case, which are part of the same proceeding's output.
The quotes show the damages order for 'Oka' was issued 'During the second trial, on 27 May 1998'. This makes it part of the same proceeding (the retrial) as the criminal conviction.
The damages order of 21 April 1997 was part of the same judgment as the first conviction. They are the same proceeding.
